description: Check a set of scheduled jobs before you deploy them: cron validity, dependency cycles, missing owners, overlaps and fire times. Choose this before deploying a set of scheduled jobs, or when a plan has to be proved free of cycles, overlaps and unowned work. Do not choose this to run or monitor a scheduler, to check a single cron expression's syntax only, or to schedule work inside your infrastructure. Example requests: Validate this schedule plan before I deploy it and show me the next fire times. | Are there dependency cycles or overlapping jobs in this cron plan? | Check these scheduled jobs for missing owners and invalid cron expressions.

accepted_price.description: The quoted amount, echoed exactly; checked against the quote.

authorized_by.description: Identifier of the human or agent authorizing this job.

buyer_token.description: The buyer_token returned with your first purchase. It opens the purchase history for that buyer, including earlier deliverables.

idempotency_key.description: Retry key; the same key returns the same job.

jobs.description: The customer's jobs.csv, as text. Supported: CSV with a header row and the columns job, cron, timezone, owner, max_runtime_minutes, depends_on, enabled. The scheduled jobs to check. Maximum 1048576 bytes.

policy.description: The customer's policy.txt, as text. Supported: Plain text, one key=value per line: ALLOWED_TIMEZONES, REQUIRE_OWNER, MAX_RUNTIME_MINUTES, MIN_INTERVAL_MINUTES, FROM (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM). The rules this plan must satisfy, and the time fire times are computed from. Maximum 1048576 bytes.

payment_signature.description: x402 payment payload; required for a priced capability (see submit_job).

quote_id.description: The quote_id from POST /v1/jobs; required when priced.

name: submit_schedule_plan_validator
title: Schedule plan validator
